name: windows-restart-cancel
title: Cancel the restart
description: Cancels a restart that is counting down (shutdown /a). It cannot cancel a restart Windows Update itself has scheduled.
measure: Set-ArhPlan $true 'Cancel a restart that is counting down, if there is one'
apply: if ($code -eq 1116) { Add-ArhNote 'No restart was counting down'; exit 0 }
if ($code -eq 0) { Add-ArhNote 'Restart cancelled' } else { Add-ArhNote "shutdown.exe /a exit $code $out" }
